prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. Five amateur adult actors aged 28 to 44 stand in a compact line on a small theatre stage, holding hands and making their first curtain-call bow. Give them distinct faces and ordinary bodies, including a bald man, a silver-streaked woman and a redhead. A plain deep-red curtain and soft amber stage light frame the proud, slightly nervous group; no audience faces are needed. Refined warm lifestyle editorial photography with considered light and relaxed expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional composition and anatomy requirements: Exact 16:9 wide establishing photograph of exactly five complete separate adult actors, no more and no fewer. Group them close enough that all five heads and linked hands fit comfortably within the central 60 percent width; leave substantial stage and red curtain at both sides. Give them simple unbranded everyday rehearsal clothing. Trace each arm naturally from the correct shoulder to its wrist; each inner hand link contains only the two adjacent people's hands. Outer actors have one free hand each. All five take a shallow natural bow, heads angled slightly up enough to see distinct proud faces.
Crop safety is essential: use a wider full-stage view and a compact five-person line occupying the middle half of the frame. BOTH OUTERMOST ACTORS KEEP THEIR FREE HAND FLAT AGAINST THEIR OWN THIGH, with elbows bent close to the torso; nobody reaches or stretches sideways. Keep the complete five people, heads, feet and every hand link clearly inside a central 4:3 crop, with no important arm or hand near either side edge. The entire group should be visibly smaller in the scene, surrounded by broad curtain margins.
review: Reviewed replacement wide photo: exactly five complete adult actors make a shallow bow before a red curtain. Ten legs/feet and naturally connected arms are visible; four inner hand links contain plausible adjacent hands. Both outer free hands rest against their own thighs, so all people, faces and gestures remain intact in central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops. PNG 1672x941.
